title: SimpleTrigger grace study: NNNC's adopted 24 h grace window on the two SimpleTrigger reference books
label: PROVISIONAL -- 2022 (3 folds) is the confirmatory window; 2023-26 is EXPLORATORY (late-half replays were seen in screen.json, and the window was used by 027/028)

value.why: fixed, not selected: the value adopted on NNNC (research/nnnc_framework, ed6049b). No grid choice is made here.

rule.gain: sum of per-fold return_pct, arm minus its control
rule.A_2023_26: nnnc_switches.judge.judge_one PASS: early gain > 0 AND late gain > 0 AND paired and both risk verdicts map to pass (15 folds)
rule.B_2022: 2022 gain > 0 AND paired verdict maps to pass AND both risk verdicts map to pass (3 folds)
rule.promotion: grace is shared by every family by definition (utils/FamilyExits FORBIDDEN_KEYS). Both families ADOPT -> propose ARM_D_OPEN / LEGACY presets 24 h. One family only -> report; the preset stays 6.5 h and a per-family grace is a user decision.

screen.expectation: REV passes 2023-26; MOM fails late. Arms historically keep ~0-0.7x of a grace replay gain (re-sequencing).

prior_evidence: 028: grace 12 h (C4) on gated reversion stopped at feasibility on 2022 -- stop-exit recovery 0.469 < 0.50 and replay gain <= 0 in 2022; the 2023-26 exploratory C4 arm (12 h) gained +8.44 pp in total and +6.26 late vs st_book_rev2
NNNC 24 h was adopted on 2023-26 only; no NNNC model covers 2022
